subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve the PR's omitted `allowBots` default that admits bot-authored group messages, or should bot-authored Feishu traffic require an explicit restrictive setting before merge?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive channel policy choice: the PR argues omitted accept preserves current Feishu behavior, while sibling channels generally make bot admission explicit or restrictive by default.

options.title: Approve Omitted Accept Default
options.body: Keep omitted `allowBots` admitting Feishu bot-authored messages, relying on self-filtering and shared loop protection as the upgrade guard after the branch is refreshed.

options.title: Require Explicit Bot Admission
options.body: Change Feishu so bot-authored messages are ignored or mention-gated unless operators explicitly set `allowBots`, trading bot-to-bot convenience for a stricter upgrade posture.

options.title: Pause For Channel Owner Redesign
options.body: Hold the PR until the Feishu channel owner defines a broader bot-admission and notification policy across automatic replies, message tools, cards, and streaming.

recommendation.title: Approve Omitted Accept Default
recommendation.body: Keep omitted `allowBots` admitting Feishu bot-authored messages, relying on self-filtering and shared loop protection as the upgrade guard after the branch is refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current-main conflict-sensitive Feishu dispatcher changes and has recent merge history on the affected surface.
